name: baskers-mods
description: Claude Code interface mods: guardrails, session telemetry, an asks pane, a GOV.UK house-style brief, a decision log and ship commands

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Denies destructive shell commands and blocks credential-shaped strings before they are written or echoed

plugins.name: session-pulse
plugins.description: Context fill on the status line, spend above the prompt, and a chime when a long run finishes

plugins.name: task-pane
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat listing everything you asked for this session, ticked as each lands

plugins.name: house-style
plugins.description: Adds GOV.UK content style, WCAG 2.2 AA and Service Standard expectations to the system prompt, toggleable per machine

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: Catches decisions stated in conversation and appends them, dated, to memory/decisions.md

plugins.name: ship-kit
plugins.description: /adr drafts a numbered Architecture Decision Record; /ship runs the repo's own checks and pushes only when they are green
